# handlers

```go
import "banyan/management-server/handlers"
```

Package handlers provides HTTP endpoint handlers for the Banyan management server. It includes handlers for basic endpoints, peer management, service discovery, proxying, tunneling, libp2p operations, routing, and WebSocket connections.

<a name="GetFigDataForAlias"></a>
## func [GetFigDataForAlias](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/management-server/handlers/service.go#L210>)

```go
func GetFigDataForAlias(alias string, addonName string) (types.FigFile, bool)
```

GetFigDataForAlias returns the full fig data for an alias. If addonName is non\-empty, it returns only the fig from that addon. If addonName is empty, it returns the first available fig from any addon.

<a name="GetServiceKeysForAlias"></a>
## func [GetServiceKeysForAlias](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/management-server/handlers/service.go#L157>)

```go
func GetServiceKeysForAlias(alias string, addonName string) ([]string, bool)
```

GetServiceKeysForAlias returns the recorded root key hex strings for an alias. If addonName is non\-empty, it returns only keys discovered via that addon. If addonName is empty, it returns the union of keys from all addons for that alias.

<a name="SetServiceKeysForAlias"></a>
## func [SetServiceKeysForAlias](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/management-server/handlers/service.go#L89>)

```go
func SetServiceKeysForAlias(alias string, keys []string, addonName string)
```

SetServiceKeysForAlias records root key hex strings for an alias under a specific addon \(case\-insensitive alias key\) If addonName is empty, it records under "\_\_local\_\_" \(for file\-based/local figs\).

<a name="SetServiceKeysForAliasWithExpiry"></a>
## func [SetServiceKeysForAliasWithExpiry](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/management-server/handlers/service.go#L121>)

```go
func SetServiceKeysForAliasWithExpiry(alias string, keys []string, expiry time.Time, addonName string)
```

SetServiceKeysForAliasWithExpiry records keys for an alias \(scoped to addonName\) and schedules automatic removal after expiry. If expiry is zero or in the past, it removes the alias immediately.

```go
func (sh *ServiceHandlers) HandleBeaconFigs(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
```

HandleBeaconFigs implements the /services/beacons/figs endpoint to return signed fig files for all active service beacons. Request body may include \{"nonce":"hex"\} or \{"requesterPeerId":"peerid"\}. If neither is provided, uses this node's peer ID as the requester.

<a name="ServiceHandlers.HandleBeaconKill"></a>
### func \(\*ServiceHandlers\) [HandleBeaconKill](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/management-server/handlers/service.go#L832>)

```go
func (sh *ServiceHandlers) HandleBeaconKill(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
```

HandleBeaconKill implements the beacon kill endpoint to permanently stop and remove a service beacon. Supports both legacy \(no hash\) and new \(with hash\) URL patterns:

- /services/beacon/kill or /services/stop \(legacy: kills first beacon only\)
- /services/beacon/kill/\{serviceKeyHash\} \(new: kills specific beacon\)

<a name="ServiceHandlers.HandleBeaconSuspend"></a>

```go
func (sh *ServiceHandlers) HandleBeaconSuspend(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
```

HandleBeaconSuspend implements the beacon suspend endpoint to temporarily suspend service announcements while keeping the beacon active for replies. Supports both legacy \(no hash\) and new \(with hash\) URL patterns:

- /services/beacon/suspend \(legacy: suspends first beacon only\)
- /services/beacon/suspend/\{serviceKeyHash\} \(new: suspends specific beacon\)

HandleFigs implements the /services/figs endpoint to list fig files in the configured figs directory and display alias cache information. If the request path ends with "/verbose", it includes full fig JSON content.

HandleFind implements the /services/find endpoint for service discovery. It supports finding services by compressed public key, fig file location, or alias. When an alias is provided, it attempts resolution via addons with local fallback.


HandleServiceFigByKey implements the /services/fig/\{key\} endpoint to return a signed fig file for a specific service key. URL format: /services/fig/\{compressedPublicKeyHex\} Request body may include either \{"nonce":"hex"\} or \{"requesterPeerId":"peerid"\}. ```
